title: A2UIVerse catalog artifact descriptor
description: artifact.json at the root of a catalog artifact (catalog.json, artifact). Written by the pack tool; validated by the marketplace at publish, the registry at install and the client at load, with one compiled schema. Versioned with the sdk; a change to its shape is additive.

catalogId.description: The catalog's id — CATALOG.id, equal to the catalogId inside the schema file. Not necessarily a resolvable URI (A2UI).

entry.description: The one ESM, relative to the artifact's root; a key of files.

schema.description: The catalog's catalog.json, relative to the artifact's root; a key of files.

hostInterface.description: The version of the host-module interface the entry was built against — the A2UI version the host lends.

additionalProperties.description: The file's SHA-256 digest, base64, in the sha256-<base64> form.

files.description: Every file of the artifact but this descriptor, by path relative to the artifact's root, with its hash.

package.description: The catalog package the artifact was packed from, as its package.json names it.

packedBy.description: The pack tool build that wrote the artifact.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the artifact's root: no leading slash, no .. segment, no backslash.
